name: prignano.ai
tagline: The shared look for prignano.ai and every site under it.
summary: Colors, dark mode and the shared header for prignano.ai and its subdomains, as one CSS file and a small script with no build step.

--card.use: Cards, the avatar ring fill and the theme toggle.

--accent.use: Links, focus rings and the call-to-action pill.

--active.use: Live or success state, always with a word.

--art-bg.use: Placeholder art behind project cards (a gradient).

display.use: The name in the header and page headings; tight letter spacing (-0.02em).

body.use: Everything else. The system stack only: no web fonts to host or load.

assets.use: The token stylesheet and header styles. Sites import it before their own styles.

required.text: The shared header from headerHtml(): avatar, name, bio, the shared links and the theme toggle.

rules: Say what a thing does, not how it is built.
Colors only through the tokens in theme.css; a new color is added there first, with light and dark values.
Dark mode follows the system until the reader picks one, and the pick is shared across the subdomains.
Import a tagged version of the package; never copy theme.css by hand or load it from a CDN.
No sideways scroll at 390px; light and dark both designed.
